leadText:
Billy (Japanese: ビリー Billy) is a character of the day who appeared in Out of Their Elements!. Billy is a circus performer specializing in types.

Billy was first seen practicing a performance alongside his nicknamed Toril, which he planned to evolve into a during the next performance. While talking to , Goh, and Chloe, a Fire Stone was accidentally dropped on his Eevee, causing him to evolve into . 's Eevee accidentally became a Jolteon, so Billy took her instead, but she refused to listen to his commands. While practicing with his other Pokémon, Toril showed off his and Billy was able to come up with a plan which involved Harmony and Chloe's Eevee to do a performance.

After their performance, Billy provided Chloe with a Thunder Stone so that Chloe could evolve her Eevee into a Jolteon one day.

He reappeared in a flashback in Infinite Possibilities!.

In Heroes Unite!, Billy reappeared in a fantasy, alongside other Trainers Chloe and her Eevee met.
